name: Amicorp FS (UK) plc
summary: Amicorp FS (UK) plc, established in 1995 and headquartered in London, United Kingdom, offers a comprehensive range of financial and operational support services. The company specializes in providing fund administration, business process outsourcing (BPO), and governance and compliance solutions to investment funds, asset managers, and family offices primarily within the UK. Its fund administration division handles critical tasks such as new fund onboarding, registrar and transfer agency operations, precise net asset value (NAV) computations, and the preparation of detailed financial statements. In the realm of governance and compliance, Amicorp assists clients with anti-money laundering (AML) procedures, directorship services, board-level support, environmental, social, and governance (ESG) advisory, and various tax reporting requirements including FTACA and CRS. Additionally, the firm delivers tailored business process outsourcing (BPO) services, encompassing accounting and corporate administration for general partners, investment management companies, and special purpose vehicles (SPVs), along with other essential back-office functions. While serving its UK client base, Amicorp FS (UK) plc maintains a significant global footprint with operational presence in numerous countries, including Curacao, the Bahamas, Barbados, Chile, Brazil, Mexico, Luxembourg, Malta, Cyprus, Singapore, Hong Kong, Mauritius, China, and India.
